issue.title: Add a "This and following" scope for private event notes on recurring events
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-ji.6 (note #4) as a planned follow-up of epic bob-cli-ji (plan 202611/private_gcal_event_notes.md § Follow-ups); triaged by the bob-cli-ji land agent.

## Proposal
Add a third private-event-note scope, "This and following", for recurring Google events: a note that applies from one occurrence onward (for example after a series changes location). v1 ships only `scope: event` (one occurrence) and `scope: series` (all events, keyed by Google's recurringEventId). Google models "this and following" edits by splitting the series into a new recurringEventId, so a design must decide whether to key on the split series or on (series, from-date) and how precedence slots between event and series layers.

## Where
`src/native/gcal/journal.rs` (NoteScope, fold), `model.rs::apply_notes` precedence, `note.rs` scope prompt / `-s`, write JSON `scope`, docs/gcal-notes.md, and the Mac Event note scope control in bob-mac-capture.
